head.title: First|*things* first.
head.lead: This site is a portfolio piece. Here is what is fictional, how form data is handled and where the images come from.

notice.title: Demo project
notice.text: Terapia Zen does not exist. There are no real sessions, bookings or payments.

sections.title: What is fictional
paragraphs: The Terapia Zen brand, the therapist Helena Prado, her background and training, the client stories, the session prices, the hours, the address and the contact details were invented to demonstrate a website for integrative therapies.

The contact details point to harmless destinations: a phone number with a non-existent area code, an email on a domain reserved for examples (.example) and a link to the Instagram home page rather than a real profile.

sections.title: Health notice
paragraphs: The descriptions of the practices are illustrative and are not health advice. Integrative practices complement, and never replace, medical or psychological care.
In an emergency, contact a health service or your local emergency number.

sections.title: Privacy and data
paragraphs: The contact form is for demonstration only: it checks the fields in your browser and shows a confirmation, but nothing is sent or stored.
This site uses no cookies, stores nothing in your browser and has no analytics or advertising tools. Fonts and images are served by the site itself, with no third-party services.
The WhatsApp and Instagram links lead to external services, which follow their own privacy policies.

sections.title: Images and credits
paragraphs: The photographs are from Unsplash, used under the Unsplash License. The people and places shown have no connection to the fictional brand.
